context: Sakura interviews a manager about expanding into Asia.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business interview; vocabulary (アジア/営業/とにかく/広告/いれ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: アジアでの営業は、順調ですか?
lines.en: Is sales in Asia going well?
lines.style: professional adult interviewer voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: とにかく、アジアに力を入れています。
lines.en: Above all, we're focusing on Asia.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 広告は、現地で出すんですか?
lines.style: engaged adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ええ、アジア向けの広告を入れています。
lines.en: Yes, we run ads aimed at Asia.
lines.style: professional boss voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 営業の手応えは、どうですか?
lines.style: curious adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: とにかく、反応は良いですよ。
lines.en: In any case, the response is good.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今後も、広告に力を入れますか?
lines.en: Will you keep investing in ads?
lines.style: probing adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: アジア全体に、もっと力を入れます。
lines.en: We'll put more into Asia as a whole.
lines.style: confident boss voice, soft warm informative closing throughout
